{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
new_paid_search = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (data['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Count converted and total
converted_count = new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(new_paid_search)

# Compute fraction
fraction_converted = converted_count / total_count

# Print the results
print(f"Converted count: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total count: {total_count}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
